teacher_info.intro:
My name is Mina and I've been a language teacher for 13 years. I'm new to iTalki.
I majored in English Language and Literature and I hold a TEFL certificate.

 I have taught Serbian and English to students from all around the globe. I've lived and worked as a teacher in Poland, and then in China. I love exploring different cultures and languages! 

In addition to working as a teacher, I've also worked as a Translator (Serbian to English and vice versa) and Project Manager's Assistant in an engineering company, so I do have experience in business communication, business facilitation and project management. 
.
teacher_info.short_signature: Certified ESL and Serbian/Croatian teacher with 13 years of experience, self-study+live sessions
teacher_info.introduction: I got my Bachelor's degree in English Language and Literature in 2012. In my last year at university , I went to the USA to improve my language skills and concentrate on communication. After coming back and graduating, I went to Poland, where I took part in a project by the United Nations, conducting interactive workshops on various social topics with secondary school students .Soon , I got my first job at a language learning center, where I taught English and Serbian for foreigners. In 2013 I went to work in China, where I stayed for a year. I taught conversational English to students of all ages . As the last few years have been quite hectic, my Master's thesis is still a work in progress. Now, I mostly teach adults, and these are, mostly, classes of Business English or General English . As for my teaching style, first- I try to focus on conversation, yet, depending on the student's level and previously acquired knowledge, it may be necessary to return to some basic rules and formal patterns of language. I like to use videos and picture materials and discuss song lyrics or movies, as well as try to get my students to be creative and create short stories/ songs/alternative endings of movies, stories, etc. I'm trained in the NTC method of teaching, and I like to base my lessons on the principles of creative, rather than reproductive learning. I can teach Pre-Intermediate, Intermediate or Advanced students.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
My courses are highly structured, and there is a specific and clear objective for every single class and every single week.

I always assign homework, as well as self-study assignments to be done prior to the live session. After each cycle of lessons (on average-it's once in 2 weeks), there is a revision conversation session in which I assess the student's progress and propose a plan for further work.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I mostly employ the Communicative Language Teaching Method (CLT) and the Flipped Classroom Model. Firstly, I provide my student with the new language in context. Secondly, I guide him/her to deduce the rules and language patterns from the context, if/when needed. Finally, the student gets to practice the language through communicative activities. 
I like to assign homework for further practice.

teacher_info.intro:
Hi, I'm Nemanja. I'm proud of learning English at a very young age all by myself. It wasn't hard—just listening to words from a screen, reading subtitles, and BAM! A 6-year-old who knows two languages.
Later, when English was taught at school, I was bored in class, as it felt repetitive. When the internet era arrived, many struggled with English, but for me, it was easy. I navigated the web effortlessly, long before others, thanks to not having a language barrier.
Today, I consider myself a near-native speaker, comfortable talking about anything with anyone in English.

teacher_info.intro: My name is Marko and I am an English teacher from Serbia. I am fascinated by languages and the way they offer us an insight into other cultures and I am excited to help you understand Serbian and other cultures by learning Serbian or English. I am a linguist by trade, but science in general fascinates me - history and sociology in particular - and I have a special place in my heart for literature and music. I love traveling as much as possible, but I also enjoy just having some quiet time with my friends and family. And finally, I LOVE talking, maybe a bit too much, but I am sure that will come in handy in our classes because communication is the gateway to language learning.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have a Master degree in the English language and literature, with French being my second language, and I have amassed over six years of teaching experience. I have mostly been teaching online and working with people from different cultures, but I also have significant experience in teaching in actual brick-and-mortar schools. It is my belief that a language teacher does not only teach grammar and vocabulary, but also serves as a guide through culture and values of the people who speak that language. My understanding of English-speaking cultures helps me significantly while teaching English, and I cannot wait to present my own Serbian culture to students who want to learn our language.
teacher_info.teaching_style: The purpose of my classes is giving my students an opportunity to practice languages in a relaxed, safe environment where mistakes are seen as learning opportunity. Additionally, in case of Serbian, being exposed to it on my part allows students to get a good example of what the language sounds like in "real life" and learn all the interesting peculiarities Serbian has to offer. My background in linguistics and knowledge of other languages (English, Ukrainian, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian) allows me to give students detailed explanations of different aspects of my language and language in general, so I believe that I can offer a well-rounded ticket into the Serbian speaking world.
